name: Two-pass Spectral Rendering Integral
definition: Noordmans et al. adopted Kajiya and von Herzen's two-pass algorithm for volumetric shadows, adapting opacity to spectral representation. It features shadow computation in the illumination phase and radiance accumulation in the radiation phase.
summary: The Two-pass Spectral Rendering Integral computes volumetric shadows by separating shadow computation from radiance accumulation, distinguishing itself through explicit wavelength-dependent opacity and emission spectra.
